encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδέν, πάτερ, ἐν ἀνθρώπου φύσει
ἕκαστός ἐστι καὶ λογίσασθαι κατὰ τρόπον
σύμβουλος· ὁ λογισμῷ διαφέρων πάντ᾽ ἔχει.

div.note: 2. τῷ] τὸ Α. 3. καὶ om. Α. τῷ Mein. 4. πάλιν] πόλει σύμβουλος Heimsoeth. Ind. Bonn. 1867 aest. XIII. 5. ὁ λογισμῷ διαφέρων Porson Tracts 250] ὁ. δ. λ., quod retinens Bentl. βουλῆς pro σύμβουλος. — locutionis κατὰ τρόπον exempla praebent H. Iacobi V 1071 et Cobet. N. l. 87. 8. cf. Antiphan. 39. Meinekio in duo fragmenta (v. 1. 2 et 3—5) haec dispescenti adsentiri certe non necessarium est, dum modo cum prioribus interpungas λογισμοῦ. τῷ διαθέσθαι πράγματα ἕκαστός ἐστι καὶ (non τῷ) λ. κτλ., i. e. ἕκαστος τῷ διαθέσθαι καὶ λογίσασθαι πράγματα ἄρχων ἐστίν. si duo sunt, post πράγματα suppleverim μέλλοντι. σύμβουλοι sunt oratores, non qui apud Meier. Schoem. Att. Proc. 58 commemorantur thesmothetarum σύμβουλοι. Praeterea cf. 300.
